tones: Confident and contrarian — state the uncomfortable truth without softening it
Informed analyst — you followed the latest development closely and have a take nobody else has said
Blunt and direct — no hedging, no maybe, no it depends
Storytelling with tension — something went wrong or right, here is exactly what and why
Provocative comparison — everyone believes X about the latest news, here is why that is backwards
formats: HOT TAKE: 2-3 short punchy lines. Bold opinion first. No question at the end. End with a statement so direct that readers must react.
CONTRAST: Line 1 is the hype or myth everyone believes. Line 2 starts with 'Reality:' and destroys it with a specific fact or observation. Line 3 is the implication. No question.
STORY: One specific incident or development with a real number or concrete detail. End with the hard lesson or implication — not a question.
LIST: A one-line hook, then 3 numbered items each under 45 chars. Each item is a hard truth or key fact, not generic advice.

NEWS TAKE: Reference a specific recent AI development found in the research. Give your sharp, informed take on what it actually means for builders in 2-3 lines. No question. End with the real implication.
ONE-LINER: A single sentence under 120 characters. No follow-up. Pure punch — the kind technical people screenshot and share.
